title: Promoters
subtitle: Promoters are independent participants who contribute to visibility and potential realization of creative assets by selecting and promoting works within the PonyLife coordination framework.

sections.heading: Selecting works
sections.body: Promoters may independently select any publicly listed work from the catalog. No prior approval or exclusive agreement is required. Selection reflects individual interest and initiative rather than assignment.

sections.heading: Independent promotion
sections.body: Promotion methods are self-directed. Promoters choose how, where, and to whom works are presented. The platform does not prescribe campaigns, messaging, or distribution strategies.

sections.heading: Role in coordination
sections.body: Promoters form a distributed visibility layer within the ecosystem. Their actions contribute to experimentation with how creative assets reach audiences, markets, and potential realization pathways.

sections.heading: Outcomes and reporting
sections.body: Outcomes may include sales, exhibitions, licenses, partnerships, or other externally observable results. Promoters may report outcomes to support transparency and system learning. Reporting does not imply compensation, validation, or guaranteed recognition.
